title: Global Hom into a prescribed Roos limit
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E/Q_l, and a separated finite-type D.k-scheme X. For any normalized DVR tower T and any integral constructible object M with IntegralDualizingLimitPresentation l E D hl X T M.obj, there is a natural isomorphism integralDualizingGlobalHom l E X M.obj ≅ integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ⋙ CoefTower.totalLimit R, where R=integralDualizingCoefficients l E. No identification of T's finite terms with dualizing objects is assumed.

proof.text: Obtain the uniqueness isomorphism between the presented object M.obj and the chosen derived limit.
Use the canonical global-Hom comparison for the chosen limit, then transport it along the object isomorphism by functoriality of derived internal Hom and sections.

lean.statement:
theorem integralDualizing_mapping_tower_limit
    (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl)
    (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (hM : IntegralDualizingLimitPresentation l E D hl X T M.obj) :
    Nonempty (integralDualizingGlobalHom l E X M.obj ≅
      integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ⋙
        CoefTower.totalLimit (integralDualizingCoefficients l E))
